Disappointing
Aug 2026 • Family
Nothing extraordinary on the gastronomic side. However, the prices are expensive. There was a health issue with an appetizer (amuse-bouche) presented....that, at a stretch, happens; what is disappointing is how the staff handled the event. No gesture on the bill; they were content to just change the appetizer with apologies. There is no way to contact them on Instagram or Facebook to give them constructive criticism in private. When working with this price range, you have to be impeccable, and when an incident occurs, you must be equipped so that the customer is not frustrated like I am now... and yes, it is a question of $$$$.
